newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - Sprint response on deal rumor.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - Sprint response on deal rumor.

text.p: Sprint said at an investors conference that a deal with Cable and Wireless would not be possible because of a standstill pact between the two companies.
A full text of Sprint's press release follows.

KANSAS CITY, March 19 /PRNewswire/ -- In comments this morning at an investors conference, William T. Esrey, Sprint Chairman and CEO, stated, "Sprint does not normally comment on rumors, but in this case, a reported deal with Cable & Wireless supported by France Telecom could not be possible because of the terms of a standstill agreement Sprint has with France Telecom and Deutsche Telekom."
France Telecom has issued a total denial of the story.
